# Psychiatry Clinics

This folder catalogs specialized psychiatric outpatient clinics across Denmark that are evaluated in the national ADHD quality database. The pages detail the diagnostic and treatment performance of specific departments—tracking their compliance with somatic examinations, environmental observations, and psychotherapy metrics. Together, these records highlight both exceptional outliers that meet stringent national standards and facilities struggling with systemic resource constraints and cross-sectoral coordination deficits.

## Pages

- [[aabenna-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|"Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium"]] — A Region Syddanmark facility recognized as a rare positive outlier that successfully meets national standards for foundational ADHD diagnostic requirements and environmental observations.
- [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-skoleboern|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn]] — A specialized school-children psychiatry department under Aarhus Universitetshospital that achieved top national fulfillment rates for somatic examinations and environmental observations.
- [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-unge|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge]] — An Aarhus-based youth psychiatry clinic whose data highlights severe nationwide structural struggles, recording extremely low compliance for coordinating network meetings.
- [[hillerod-psykiatrisk-ambulatorium-boern-og-unge|"Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge"]] — A Zealand-based outpatient facility that achieved the highest fulfillment rate among larger departments for core ADHD assessment metrics, despite mixed results in younger age groups.
- [[odense-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|"Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium"]] — A Region Syddanmark clinic that stands out as the only department in the country to fully meet the standard for structured diagnostic interviews in older children, while also leading in post-diagnostic coordination.
- [[pck-psykoterapeutisk-klinik|"PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik"]] — A Region Hovedstaden facility notable for being the only department in Denmark to record a measurable fulfillment rate for the newly introduced adult ADHD psychotherapy quality indicator.
